caseName: United States Parole Commission v. Geraghty
caseNameFull: United States Parole Commission v. Geraghty

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 78-904, Deposit Guaranty National Bank v. Roper, immediately infra. Motion to substitute members of a putative class as respondents or in the alternative to intervene is deferred to hearing of the case on the merits.
